The Bulls continue their winning run!
A commanding all-round performance with both bat and ball powered UAE Bulls to their fifth win of the season, taking them into the Top 3 of the points table!
Muhammad Rohid Khan led the charge with a crucial 3/13, while valuable contributions from the batters ensured the defending champions sealed another impressive victory!
Watch 2026 | 7th NOV to 20th NOV on Star Sports & JioHotstar.
